senses.gloss:
[न. खेटत्यस्मात्; खिट् भये षिकन् [[Tv.]]] 
__1 A tree in general. 
__2 (आखेटिक) A dog trained to the chase.
a. Not wearisome, not fatigued, °त्वम् continuous flow of speech regarded as one of the वाग्गुणs of the Jainas.

[आखिट्यन्ते त्रास्यन्ते प्राणिनोऽत्र, आ-खिट्-घञ् [[Tv.]]] Hunting, chase. 
-Comp. 
-शीर्षकम् 
__1 a smooth floor or ground (कुट्टिमभेद). 
__2 a mine, cavern.

a. Hunting, frightening (as beasts of prey &c.). 
-कः A hunter; आखेटकस्य धर्मेण विभवाः स्युर्बशे नृणाम् [[Pt. 1. 129]], 388. 
-कम् Hunting. 
-Comp. 
-अटवी f. A hunting forest.

a. [आखेटे कुशलः ठक्] 
__1 Skilful in chase. 
__2 Terrible, frightful. 
-कः 
__1 A hunter. 
__2 A hound.
